result.title: DraftKV: Protecting Persistent Worlds through Hierarchical Streaming Retrieval
result.comment: Includes supplementary material. Code and project page are available online
result.summary: Interactive video world models enable action- and camera-controlled exploration, yet struggle to maintain consistent spatial geometry and appearance when revisiting previously explored locations. Historical KV caches help auto-regressive video diffusion models maintain long-term consistency, but their retrieval and attention computation introduce substantial latency as history grows. We propose DraftKV, a training-free framework that retrieves historical KV caches based on geometric grounding and query-conditioned relevance, while combining CPU offloading with tile-wise streaming attention to reduce GPU memory usage and inference latency. Theoretically, we show that draft relevance reproduces the mean branch of full-resolution block relevance exactly, so its deviation is confined to the $β$-weighted max branch, and we bound retrieval utility loss in terms of the measured Top-K selection overlap. We further show that draft relevance cannot distinguish blocks with similar pooled descriptors regardless of camera pose, motivating geometric grounding before refinement. Then, we introduce streaming CG-Attention, which overlaps CPU-to-GPU KV transfers with attention computation through tile-wise streaming, hiding transfer latency while maintaining bounded GPU memory usage. Experiments across diverse model families show that DraftKV achieves superior generation quality and consistency while achieving $3.27\times$ end-to-end speedup and 42.2% peak GPU memory reduction over other CPU-offloaded KV cache retrieval methods. Notably, DraftKV enables high-quality interactive world generation with historical KV retrieval on a single H100 GPU using SolarWM-33B.

AI.brief_summary: DraftKV 针对交互式视频世界模型中长时历史一致性问题，提出免训练框架：先以几何 grounding 与查询条件相关性检索历史 KV 缓存，再结合 CPU offload 与 tile 级流式注意力降低显存占用与推理延迟，并给出检索近似与 Top-K 重合度的误差界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按查询相关性对历史状态做 Top-K 检索、以及缓存与注意力结构近似的分析，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选和 latent 缓存/注意力结构对相似度的影响提供核查线索；但论文目标是视频世界模型的时空一致性，并非多模态推理。
